solves.reasoning: Random sampling was a good shortcut (not obstacle). Full dataset gives freedom (not restriction). A fitting example (not misleading).
More reuseable than ordinary (not exceptional) pictures. Freedom to explore (not ignore). As with conventional (not innovative) cameras.
It is closer (not farther) to all data. Results in loss (not gain) of data. Camera captures (not releases) rays.
③ burden is wrong — original says 'freedom to explore', burden contradicts the positive meaning.
② exceptional is wrong — original says 'ordinary pictures', exceptional is the opposite meaning in this comparison.
③ preserving is wrong — original says 'converting a digital image into a smaller file', preserving means keeping unchanged.
Random ___ was a good shortcut — sampling completes 'random sampling' which is the passage topic.
Provides a lot more ___ to explore — freedom fits (positive benefit of having full dataset).
Before she presses the ___ — shutter (photographer action with camera).
Shortcut means a quicker way = quick method. Barrier/long route/slow process are all opposites.
Conventional = traditional (standard/established). Advanced and novel are antonyms.
Aspects = features (both mean facets/characteristics of something).
Entire means whole/complete. Fractional means partial — the only true antonym among the choices.
Random means without order. Systematic means methodical/organized — direct antonym.
(A) wheat field = 들판 (agricultural land). (B) light field = 영역 (domain of light rays).
Following what is generally done/believed = conventional. Digital/random/fitting don't match.
The ___ of large data — article + ___ + of requires a noun. analyze → analysis.
Unlike ___ cameras — adjective needed before noun. convention → conventional.
Makes it possible to do that ___ — afterwards (later, after collecting all info).
Which ___ of an image to focus on — element (specific part/component).
